jobs.occupation: Chapter Lead - Automation Engineers - Tribe Customer Servicing & Efficiency - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

Do you want to play a key role in the digital transformation of Belgium’s largest bank? Are you a driven people manager with a strong technical background, eager to lead a team of developers to the next level? If so, you could be our new Chapter Lead Developers within the Tribe Customer Servicing & Efficiency! 

Within our tribe, we focus on innovative customer interactions through our Contact Center platform and advanced automation (including robotics and ServiceNow). Our goal is to deliver efficient, user-friendly solutions that simplify life for both customers and employees. Additionally, we play a crucial role in fraud prevention and detection, protecting our bank and customers from threats. 

Our multidisciplinary teams (squads) combine IT and business expertise to develop technological solutions that enhance customer service and process efficiency. As part of Agile Impulse, you’ll work in a dynamic, agile environment where innovation and collaboration are key. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

As Chapter Lead of Automation Engineers, you’ll lead a skilled development team while serving as both a people manager and a technical expert. You’ll report directly to the IT Tribe Lead and be part of the tribe leadership team. 

 

As a People Manager, you will: 

• You nurture the colleagues in your chapter by ensuring they develop the right skills & knowledge and you manage with them their career plans; 
• You build, together with your peer chapter leads, on a continuous changing and challenging sourcing strategy. 
• You recruit new chapter members in line with current & future needs of the tribe and ensure a good onboarding of them; you are also in charge of the knowledge management; 
• You ensure an open and transparent communication with resource suppliers thinking along in the multiple established value based partnerships. 
• You support chapter members on difficult or complex questions and support them in the necessary changes by developing their agile maturity 
• You provide during the year continuous feedback to your chapter members and are responsible for the annual evaluation and the renumeration decisions in your chapter. 
• You contribute to the daily functioning of the tribe and represent your chapter in the tribe leadership team 
• You help building an open feedback culture at all levels in our tribe and cultivate an open communication and a high level of trust. You act as a sponsor in one or multiple communities of practice (CoP) within the tribe. 
 

As an Expert, you will: 

• Initiate and lead improvements within the tribe based on your technical expertise. 
• Collaborate closely with squads, product owners, agile coaches, and stakeholders to continuously enhance ways of working, tools, and skills. 
• Translate technical needs into strategic development points for your chapter and the Developers Community of BNP Paribas Fortis. 
• Being part of the tribe leadership team, you dare to step outside of your role to intervene when needed on other transversal roles or topics like incident management, vulnerabilities management, DevOps Embedding,… 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• At least 2 years of experience in a similar role. 
• Experience in coaching and mentoring teams. 
• Strong knowledge of software engineering and development/testing methodologies; a technical background in Robotic Process Automation (Blue Prism, UiPath, etc. is a plus. 
• Excellent interpersonal skills-you understand your team’s needs and foster a growth mindset. 
• Agile expertise-you’re familiar with agile teams and methodologies. 
• Passion for innovation and a proactive attitude. 
• Fluent in Dutch or French (oral and written) with strong English skills.

Your role is structured around four main areas, each contributing to the stability and continuous improvement of the IT infrastructure.

License Management (20%)

You will be responsible for managing software licenses, including Microsoft subscriptions and on-premises licensing, Oracle, VMware, Apple, and other software vendors, monitoring software acquisitions, renewals, and retirements, ensuring license compliance and validating software usage and requests.

Contract Management (20%)

• Managing support and maintenance contract renewals.
• Monitoring contractual commitments, service costs, and vendor performance.
• Contributing to the preparation of technical specifications for new procurement processes.
• Ensuring suppliers comply with technical requirements and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Data Center & Infrastructure (10%)

• Oversee the day-to-day management of data center facilities operated by external partners.
• Coordinate maintenance and operational activities.
• Assess physical infrastructure requirements, including power, cooling, and rack capacity.
• Manage the installation, relocation, and decommissioning of IT equipment.
Capacity & Asset Management (50%)

• Manage the complete lifecycle of hardware and software assets.
• Coordinate the retirement, redeployment, or resale of IT equipment.
• Maintain an accurate IT asset inventory and ensure the Configuration Management Database remains up to date.
• Optimize asset utilization and manage hardware stock levels.
• Prepare and monitor CAPEX and OPEX budgets related to IT infrastructure.
• Forecast infrastructure capacity requirements over a 1- to 4-year horizon in close collaboration with the Architecture team.
• Ensure compliance with IT equipment standards and the corporate IT service catalogue.

Profile

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Engineering/Business Administration with an IT specialization, or equivalent through relevant professional experience.
• Proven experience in IT infrastructure, capacity planning, IT asset management, software license management, and vendor contract management.
• Solid understanding of data center environments, ITIL processes, IT asset inventories, and CMDB management.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft, Oracle, VMware, and Apple licensing models.
• Experience preparing and managing CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
• Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments, including virtualization, storage, databases, and Windows-based systems.
• Languages: French , Dutch and English
• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
• Excellent analytical abilities with a proactive approach to optimization and long-term planning.
• Able to work independently while taking ownership and responsibility.
• Clear communicator who enjoys collaborating in a professional and approachable manner.

jobs.occupation: IT Tribe Architect - DevEx & Cloud - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

We design the future of banking by shaping secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions that align business vision with cutting-edge IT. Our team of expert architects bridges the gap between security, agility, and customer-centric innovation, ensuring every system-from cloud to core banking-is built for performance, compliance, and seamless integration.

AND IN DETAIL

• You will design and validate solutions for development frameworks, platforms, and toolchains, enabling Dev Engineers to build and deploy scalable cloud-native applications.
• You will produce and maintain high-quality architecture documentation—including blueprints, solution architectures, and reference architectures—to ensure alignment with architectural standards, security policies, and business requirements.
• You will support other architects and development teams by providing expert guidance on scalable, resilient design patterns and cloud-native best practices.
• You will demystify complex technical concepts (e.g., service mesh, continuous delivery, infrastructure automation) to ensure solutions are secure, performant, and developer friendly.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Cloud-Native Development: Deep expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-native applications (microservices, containers) with a focus on scalability, resilience, and observability.
• Kubernetes & OpenShift: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift 
• IBM Cloud Platform: Proficiency in IBM Cloud services (e.g., Openshift and other native IBM Cloud services like EventStream, COS,…)
• Toolchain & Automation: Strong background in DevOps toolchains (CI/CD pipelines, GitOps) and infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, scripting) to streamline development and deployment workflows.
• Java Frameworks: Experience with modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot) and their integration with cloud-native ecosystems.
• Developer Experience (DevEx): Ability to design and improve developer tools, platforms, and workflows to enhance productivity, reduce friction, and foster adoption of cloud-native practices.
• You are fluent in English (oral and written). Basic knowledge of Dutch or French is an asset.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Build the backbone of our digital future as a Web Infrastructure Architect in our Agile Production Services (APS) tribe. Based in Brussels (HQ), you’ll design, secure, and optimize the high-performance web infrastructure that powers our business, working alongside a diverse, skilled team to push boundaries in scalability, security, and cloud innovation.

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and shaping enterprise-grade web solutions, this is where your expertise will make an impact.

 

AND IN DETAIL

You won’t just maintain systems, you’ll engineer resilience, performance, and security into every layer of our web infrastructure. 
Here’s how:

Design with precision

• Craft Detailed Technical Designs (DTDs) that turn business needs into scalable, future-proof architectures.
• Define reference architectures to standardize how we build, deploy, and secure web applications.
Solve deep technical problems

• Debug complex incidents using APM tools, logs, and traces, finding root causes and fixing them for good.
• Optimize performance by analyzing application flows, bottlenecks, and resource usage (think: WebSphere tuning, Kubernetes scaling, TLS handshakes).
Secure and modernize

• Harden our web hosting (WebSphere, Tomcat, IIS) and security layers (F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, oAuth2, HSM).
• Lead cloud migration and optimization (IaaS/PaaS) while keeping costs and risks in check.
• Collaborate and influence
• Work closely with DevOps, Security, and Development teams to ensure designs are practical, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
• Mentor and guide, your expertise will help raise the bar for the entire team.
• Keep us ahead of the curve
• Monitor, measure, and improve, proactively spotting risks and opportunities in our web infrastructure.
• Drive cost-efficiency initiatives, from right-sizing resources to decommissioning legacy systems.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who lives and breathes web infrastructure with the skills to back it up.

 

Core Technical Skills (Must-Have)

• 5+ years in infrastructure architecture, with hands-on experience in:
• Web Application Hosting: WebSphere, Kubernetes, IIS, Tomcat
• Web Security: F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, HSM, oAuth2, TLS
• Cloud Environments: IaaS/PaaS (design, migration, optimization)
• Performance troubleshooting: APM tools, logging, tracing, capacity planning
• Incident analysis: Root-cause investigation for web infrastructure issues
 

How You Work

• Analytical and data-driven: You don’t guess, you measure, analyze, and optimize.
• Collaborative: You thrive in cross-functional teams (Security, DevOps, Development) and can explain complex tech simply.
• Proactive and pragmatic: You spot problems before they happen and solve them efficiently.
 

Nice-to-Haves

• Languages: Fluent in English (mandatory); French/Dutch is a plus.
• Education/Certs: Master’s degree (or equivalent experience). TOGAF, ITIL, or Agile certifications are a bonus.
 

Soft Skills

• A team player who’s autonomous, adaptable, and ready to tackle challenges in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

• Define test objectives and E2E strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
• Coordinate functional, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) across different project phases.
• Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to communicate test progress, risks, and outcomes.
• Lead test data management and provisioning in accordance with industry best practices and compliance norms.
• Manage defect tracking and risk mitigation strategies to ensure timely project delivery and quality standards.
• Provide actionable quality reports and insights to support go/no-go decisions based on readiness and trends.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the quality assurance community.

Requirements

• Experience in creating comprehensive E2E test plans.
• Experience in coordinating and managing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities with business stakeholders.
• Experience in coordinating Agile or Scrum teams.
• Knowledge of technical IT concepts including APIs, Web Services, Protocols, and Frontend/Backend architectures.
• Ability to assess test scope and recognize non-functional testing needs.
• Strong stakeholder management skills and a critical, challenging mindset.
• Proactive, autonomous, and result-driven approach.
• You are fluent in English with French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to contribute to internal quality assurance knowledge-sharing initiatives.
